description_excerpt: Job Description You will be joining an international team with main responsibilities as follows: • Develop embedded based software (BSW) and application software for household appliance. • Participate in full development cycle (Requirement, Design, Coding, Testing) • Analyzing requirements, design and develop embedded BSW. • Develop and execute unit and functional development/tests. • Code review, design review, solution review. • Conduct knowledge sharing to build up the team competencies. • Provide technical proposal, estimation for new project. • Involve directly to customer discussions.…
